dataFlows.transformKql: source | extend EventType = tostring(['type']) | extend TimeGenerated = iif(isnotnull(todatetime(occurredAt)), todatetime(occurredAt), now()), EventId = tostring(id), Data = data | extend AlertId = tostring(data['alertId']), AlertTier = tostring(data['tier']), AlertReason = tostring(data['reason']), IssueKind = tostring(data['issue']['kind']), IssueState = tostring(data['issue']['state']), StealsLogins = tobool(data['issue']['stealsLogins']), RemoteCode = tobool(data['issue']['remoteCode']) | extend ThreatId = iif(EventType == "alert.raised", tostring(data['issue']['threatId']), tostring(data['threatId'])), ExtensionId = iif(EventType == "threat.detected", tostring(data['threats'][0]['chromeExtensionId']), iif(EventType == "threat.resolved", tostring(data['chromeExtensionId']), tostring(data['issue']['chromeExtensionId']))), ExtensionName = iif(EventType == "threat.detected", tostring(data['threats'][0]['extensionName']), tostring(data['issue']['extensionName'])), Severity = iif(EventType == "threat.detected", tostring(data['threats'][0]['riskLevel']), tostring(data['issue']['severity'])), InstallCount = iif(EventType == "threat.detected", toint(data['installCount']), toint(data['issue']['installCount'])) | extend SchemaVersion = toint(schemaVersion), AffectedMachines = toint(data['affectedMachines']), Affected = data['affected'], DashboardUrl = tostring(data['dashboardUrl']), Resolution = tostring(data['resolution']) | extend DeviceId = tostring(data['deviceId']), MachineName = tostring(data['machineName']), IdentityEmail = tostring(data['identityEmail']), Platform = tostring(data['platform']) | project TimeGenerated, EventId, EventType, SchemaVersion, AlertId, AlertTier, AlertReason, ThreatId, ExtensionId, ExtensionName, IssueKind, Severity, IssueState, StealsLogins, RemoteCode, InstallCount, AffectedMachines, Affected, DashboardUrl, Resolution, DeviceId, MachineName, IdentityEmail, Platform, Data
